name: University of Amsterdam
summary: Research university in central Amsterdam; 23 English-taught bachelor's from psychology and economics to linguistics, four capped by numerus fixus.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma needed (IB courses alone are not accepted); English as an IB exam subject covers the English requirement. Strictest maths: AA HL at grade 4 (Actuarial Science, Business Analytics, Econometrics).

apply.via: Studielink, then UvA's SIS application portal

dates.label: Deadline if you want UvA Housing (non-selective programmes)

programmes.name: Actuarial Science
programmes.about: Mathematics, statistics and data science used to calculate and manage future risks such as fires, crises and bankruptcies and their financial impact, preparing you for insurance and beyond.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May (earlier if you want UvA housing) and complete UvA Matching.

programmes.name: Ancient Studies
programmes.about: The art, literature, philosophy, history and mythology of Greek and Roman antiquity and its neighbours, studied broadly across place and time, with material culture alongside texts.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May (earlier if you want UvA housing) and complete UvA Matching.

programmes.name: Archaeology
programmes.about: Past societies and why they matter today: materials, people and landscape, and how research is presented, with fieldwork internships in the Netherlands and the Mediterranean. Run with VU Amsterdam (ACASA).
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May (earlier if you want UvA housing) and complete UvA Matching.

programmes.name: Business Administration
programmes.ib: Numerus fixus (650 English-track places): apply by 15 January; online selection test in February. Maths AA SL/HL or AI HL at grade 4.
programmes.about: Strategy, marketing, finance, management, international and digital business, with work on corporate social responsibility and the use of AI in business.
programmes.selectionNote: Numerus fixus: 650 English-track places. Apply and sign up for the online test by 15 Jan 2027; the top 225 scorers get ranked places, the middle group is drawn by lottery.

programmes.name: Business Analytics
programmes.about: Analytics, AI, machine learning, programming and data-centred management used to solve real business problems, in a programme built around data.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May (earlier if you want UvA housing) and complete UvA Matching.

programmes.name: Computational Social Science
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL/HL or AI HL at grade 4; with AI SL you need an extra maths certificate.
programmes.about: Social science and data combined to solve real social problems: from day one you work for real clients on climate, health, inequality and AI, and present your results.

needs.note: With Maths AI SL you need an extra maths certificate.

programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May (earlier if you want UvA housing) and complete UvA Matching.

programmes.name: Cultural Anthropology and Development Sociology
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL/HL or AI HL at grade 4 is highly recommended, not required.
programmes.about: How people around the world live and make sense of their surroundings, studying culture, power and inequality around climate, technology and geopolitics, and doing your own fieldwork.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May (earlier if you want UvA housing) and complete UvA Matching.

programmes.name: Econometrics and Data Science
programmes.about: Programming mathematical and statistical models, applying them to real data and explaining the results, for questions such as how firms can grow profits sustainably. Start in English or in Dutch.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May (earlier if you want UvA housing) and complete UvA Matching.

programmes.name: Economics and Business Economics
programmes.ib: Numerus fixus (850 English-track places): apply by 15 January; online selection test in February or March. Maths AA SL/HL or AI HL at grade 4.
programmes.about: A broad economics degree on the choices of people, firms and governments and their effects on society, combined with how companies are organised and run.
programmes.selectionNote: Numerus fixus: 850 English-track places. Apply and sign up for the online test by 15 Jan 2027; the top 300 scorers get ranked places, the middle group is drawn by lottery.

programmes.name: English Language and Culture
programmes.about: The literature, language and culture of the English-speaking world, taught entirely in English, tracing English from a language of Britain to a global one.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May (earlier if you want UvA housing) and complete UvA Matching.

programmes.name: European Studies
programmes.about: Europe's shifting borders, languages, institutions, traditions and populations, studied in central Amsterdam with up to 300 first-year students.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May (earlier if you want UvA housing) and complete UvA Matching.

programmes.name: Global Arts, Culture and Politics
programmes.about: Climate change, inequality and other big challenges seen through culture, politics and the arts, with four majors: human and artificial intelligence, curating the past, sustainability, or culture and social justice.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May (earlier if you want UvA housing) and complete UvA Matching.

programmes.name: Global Communication Science (Communication Science)
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL/HL or AI HL at grade 4 is highly recommended, not required.
programmes.about: How media and digital platforms shape what people see and believe across cultures, and why what goes viral in one country may be banned in another.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May (earlier if you want UvA housing) and complete UvA Matching.

programmes.name: Human Geography and Planning
programmes.about: How cities, towns and neighbourhoods work and how policy shapes daily life, from affordable housing to climate impacts, learned in small groups through research and practical plans.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May (earlier if you want UvA housing) and complete UvA Matching.

programmes.name: Linguistics
programmes.about: The structure, acquisition and diversity of the world's languages; in year 1 you also learn a new language and compare it with those you already speak.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May (earlier if you want UvA housing) and complete UvA Matching.

programmes.name: Literary and Cultural Analysis (Literary Studies)
programmes.about: Literature alongside social media, art installations, political speeches and museums, analysed from an interdisciplinary angle to address the philosophical and social questions of our time.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May (earlier if you want UvA housing) and complete UvA Matching.

programmes.name: Media and Culture
programmes.about: The global media landscape from animation and arthouse cinema to blockbusters, reality TV and AI-generated content, starting with a broad base in media history and theory.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May (earlier if you want UvA housing) and complete UvA Matching.

programmes.name: Media and Information
programmes.about: Critical study of information technologies from social media platforms to AI, preparing you for work where technology, information and culture meet.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May (earlier if you want UvA housing) and complete UvA Matching.

programmes.name: Political Science
programmes.ib: Numerus fixus (345 English-track places): apply by 15 January; places go by unweighted lottery. Maths AA SL/HL or AI HL at 4 recommended.
programmes.about: Politics beyond governments and parties: how societies function and how to make an impact in communities and the world.
programmes.selectionNote: Numerus fixus: 345 English-track places, allocated by an unweighted lottery among eligible applicants. Apply in Studielink by 15 Jan 2027.

programmes.name: Politics, Psychology, Law and Economics (PPLE)
programmes.ib: Selective: 34 IB points (6 subjects, excl. TOK/EE), Maths AA SL/HL or AI HL at 4; apply by 1 February, entrance exam 27 March 2027, then interview.
programmes.about: A small interdisciplinary college joining politics, psychology, law and economics to approach social problems from several angles and design new solutions.
programmes.selectionNote: Selective: apply between 1 October and 1 February. Grades (34 IB points over six subjects), an entrance exam and an interview decide; intake about 250.

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.ib: Numerus fixus (300 English-track places): apply by 15 January; selection tests. Maths must be an exam subject; AA SL/HL or AI HL at 4 recommended.
programmes.about: How the mind and behaviour work, to help people with challenges at work, as consumers or in mental health, in small groups with mentor meetings in years 1 and 2.

needs.note: Maths must be an exam subject; AA SL/HL or AI HL at 4 is recommended.

programmes.selectionNote: Numerus fixus: 300 English-track places. Apply by 15 Jan 2027; ranked on selection tests of psychology knowledge, analytical thinking and study skills.

programmes.name: Sign Language Linguistics (Linguistics)
programmes.about: Sign languages from around the world: their structure, acquisition and use studied as a linguist, at one of the few universities with a full programme on visual-spatial languages.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May (earlier if you want UvA housing) and complete UvA Matching.

programmes.name: Sociology
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL/HL or AI HL at grade 4 is highly recommended, not required.
programmes.about: How societies work and how social rules and inequality shape lives, across education, work, gender, class, media and politics, with research skills to improve society.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May (earlier if you want UvA housing) and complete UvA Matching.

notes: EEA nationals with an IB Diploma applying to 15 English-taught humanities and social-science programmes skip the application file and €100 fee: IBO just sends your results by 31 August.
You must finish UvA Matching, a compulsory online programme check held in spring 2027, before you can enrol in a programme without selection.
You can register for at most two numerus fixus programmes in Studielink, and Political Science fills its English track by lottery, not grades.
